To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a 1.8 pJ/bit, 12.25-25 Gb/s, wide range, low power, all-digital CDM can be implemented using digital synthesis.
we have implemented a highly adaptive AD-CDR with a wide operating range, a small active chip area and a low power dissipation.
the AD-CDRs presented in this thesis are the smallest, lowest power and most widely tunable CDRs in the literature.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a low-power, small area, and highly tunable AD-CDR.
the development and demonstration of the first wide-range, low-power, low-complexity AD-CDR.
the design, implementation, and analysis of the first all-digital CDDR that operates in a wide speed range and is adaptive to speed variations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this is the smallest area, the lowest power, and the widest range all-digital CDM solution reported in the literature.
we have demonstrated a fully integrated AD-CDR that is the smallest in area, the lowest in power consumption, the widest in operating range, and the most adaptive to date.
we demonstrate a 12.5-25 Gb/s AD-CDR that occupies a very small active chip area of just 0.050 mm2 and has the lowest power consumption of just 46 mW, while still maintaining a wide operating range.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a low-power, low-area, wide-range and adaptive AD-CDR.
we have demonstrated the smallest area, lowest power, highest operating range, and the lowest power dissipation at the lower speeds compared with the state of the art.
we have designed the first all-digital CDDR with the highest level of digital integration and a very large operating range.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of synthesized digital logic can enable a highly integrated and adaptive AD-CDR.
a fully synthesized DLF can be used to implement a low-power, wide-range, and tunable AD-CDR.
the use of a synthesized digital DLF can enable the design of highly integrated AD-CDR circuits.
